unsupported: The business was founded by Jeff Miller, a furniture designer, craftsman, teacher, and author of several woodworking books.
Miller, a former classical musician, established the shop as a base for his custom furniture practice and woodworking instruction.
Miller designs and builds one-of-a-kind furniture pieces, employing traditional joinery and turning techniques.
The shop also hosts woodworking workshops for students.
The company serves collectors, galleries, and museum curators seeking custom furniture, as well as woodworking enthusiasts through classes and instructional books and DVDs.

Miller's background in music and his extensive publishing record — including titles such as The Foundations of Better Woodworking and Chairmaking and Design — inform a design approach that emphasizes technique and craftsmanship.
The shop's focus on hand skills and small-scale production distinguishes it from larger commercial furniture makers.

Known for: Handcrafted furniture produced in a historic post office building; Award-winning designs featured in the Chicago History Museum; Author of multiple acclaimed woodworking books and DVDs; Offers hands-on woodworking workshops; Small-shop focus on traditional joinery and hand-tool techniques
